title: Receiving Payments into a Pocketwire Personal Account: Limits and the Seller Fee
content:
**Receiving limits.** Incoming payments credit the Pocketwire Personal Account balance only while the rolling 30-day total received plus the new payment stays within the plan's rolling 30-day receive limit and the ledger balance after the credit stays within the plan's maximum ledger balance; a payment that would breach either is declined back to the sender and nothing is booked. The rolling 30-day total is the sum of the payments received on the handling date and the 29 preceding calendar days, Eastern Time.

**Seller fee.** A goods-and-services payment received into a personal account carries a goods-and-services seller fee equal to the payment amount times the plan's goods-and-services seller fee rate, rounded to the cent (half up), booked as a separate fee entry on the same day; personal payments received carry no fee.

**Refund of the seller fee.** The seller fee is refunded only in the same proportion as a refund the customer sends back to the buyer through the app, and never because the customer marked a sale as personal after the fact.

| Payment received | Fee |
|---|---|
| Personal payment | None |
| Goods-and-services payment | Seller fee, as a separate fee entry on the same day |

**Worked fees (hypothetical amounts and rate)**

- A 250.00 goods-and-services payment at a 2.99 percent seller fee rate: 7.475, rounded half up to 7.48.
- The same payment, with 125.00 later refunded by the customer to the buyer through the app: half of the payment is refunded, so half of the 7.48 seller fee is refunded.
- The same payment later marked as personal by the customer: no refund of the seller fee.
